Fix declared EROFS tool extraction

The Noble tool archive contained both a populated /bin directory and a
later base-files symlink at the same path. Extract only /usr, which owns
the tools, loader, libraries, and licenses, and use those paths directly.

Allow filtered cases through the existing container-v1 lane so focused
checks retain its root coordinator and KVM guest setup. The explicit test
lane did not provide the custom guest launcher access to /dev/kvm.
